titleZh: Wonder探售Grubhub，曾2024年以6.5亿美元收购
titleOriginal: Sources: Wonder is exploring a sale of Grubhub, which it bought in 2024 for $650M; bankers have been in contact with Walmart, Target, Kroger and other retailers (Wall Street Journal)
summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Wonder正在探售Grubhub。该公司于2024年以6.5亿美元收购Grubhub后，现有银行家已接触沃尔玛、塔吉特、Kroger等零售商进行潜在收购洽谈。
